field.label: WireGuard instance
field.help: The local WireGuard instance this peer is attached to.

field.label: WireGuard peer
field.help: The WireGuard peer (client) whose endpoint is tracked via STUN.

field.label: Storage plugin
field.help: Which storage plugin instance publishes and reads this peer's endpoint.

field.label: Protocol
field.help: Which IP family to use for this peer.

field.label: Enable ping monitor
field.help: Actively probe this peer to detect and recover from stale endpoints.

field.label: Ping target
field.help: Address to ping, typically the peer's tunnel address.

field.label: Ping interval
field.help: Go duration, e.g. 1s. Leave empty to use the global default.

field.label: Ping timeout
field.help: Go duration, e.g. 1s. Leave empty to use the global default.
